newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU finalises 500 mln Ecus BSE beef aid package.
newsitem.headline: EU finalises 500 mln Ecus BSE beef aid package.

text.p: European Union farm ministers on Monday formally agreed 500-million-Ecus aid to beef farmers hit by income losses due to a drop in sales caused by a public health scare over mad cow disease, EU officials said.
The aid, which was part of a production-cutting and aid package drawn up under a political agreement in Luxembourg last month, was finalised after French concerns were resolved.
France, the main beneficiary, wanted a firm commitment that the money, which must be financed from savings in the EU's 41-billion-Ecus farm budget, would be provided in 1997.

EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler agreed to propose to add the extra aid to the 1997 draft EU budget and that an estimated 20 million Ecus for for beef promotion would be additional finance, EU official said.
The aid supplements 850-million-Ecus agreed by EU leaders in Florence in June.
